purpose: MiniMax M3 direct execution evidence. Records the provider CONTRACT (consumed from M014-S05-minimax-provider-contract.json) and the live execution POSTURE for a bounded clean direct Hermes MiniMax M3 run. In the auto-mode execution lane, T03 CANNOT open an authenticated SSH session to the live VPS (T02 phase_verdict=PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED; LFP-LF-02 forbids unattended live mutation; S02 H-INCONCLUSIVE blocks VPS readback). Therefore this artifact records an HONEST PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED verdict with explicit per-step live_execution_status markers and live_execution_blockers, mirroring the T02 fail-closed pattern and S04-T04 fail-closed BLOCKED pattern.
phase_verdict_rationale: T03 in the auto-mode execution lane can produce the provider CONTRACT (canonical provider name, endpoint mode, model spelling, key env contract, profile shape, pre-direct cleanup plan, post-direct validation requirements) but cannot OPEN AN AUTHENTICATED SSH SESSION TO THE LIVE VPS to actually run hermes-paperclip against the MiniMax endpoint. T02 phase_verdict is still PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED (upgrade wheel not installed, 6/6 pre-flight checks not passed, 4/4 patch reconciliations not completed), LFP-LF-02 forbids unattended live mutation, LFP-S02-01 forbids destructive recovery, and LFP-S02-02 restricts Paperclip restarts to the safe_restart_command only. Producing a fake 'PASS' verdict here would constitute evidence laundering — instead, T03 records PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED so T04 can later promote the verdict once an operator-confirmed live direct execution has succeeded.
live_execution_status_rationale: operator-confirmed D062 proof: bounded direct MiniMax M3 response hash
fresh_readback_via: authenticated SSH tunnel plus direct Postgres identity readback on the canonical VPS
